MENTOR: Tile, Caption and Stamp it is. That's your group.

I rendered the comp at 0 s, but the frame came back as solid purple, so I can't point out where the three layers are in it.

Here's the idea. When a layer has a **parent**, it follows the parent's position, scale and rotation, and it still plays its own animation on top. A **null** is an invisible layer you can use as a parent. You put it at the point the group should turn or scale from, parent the group to it, and then animate only the null. Your comp already has one of these: Hatch follows Hatch Rig.

Two things to keep in mind:
- Children inherit **position, scale and rotation, but not opacity or effects.** If you fade the null, nothing you can see changes.
- A null **never shows up in the render**, so it can't add anything of its own to the group's look.

Your turn: add a null with **Layer > New > Null Object**. Before you move it, tell me where the group should turn or scale from: a corner, the middle of an edge, or the middle of the group. If you only want it to slide, say that instead.
